meta.title: Optimize CLI dependencies
meta.body_summary: Optimize CLI dependency footprint by replacing heavy libraries (chalk→picocolors, node-fetch→native fetch), inlining small utilities, consolidating duplicate versions, and removing deprecated packages, aiming to reduce compressed node_modules size from ~125MB to ≤50MB.

perf_labels.notes: Large-scale dependency optimization by Devin; no human review or validation; closed automatically for inactivity after 8 days.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 5287 changed lines across 158 files, this is a large-scale refactor by absolute volume, primarily affecting many CLI source files and the lockfile. As a dependency optimization performance PR, it was closed without merge—likely due to the sweeping nature and lack of maintainer review, resulting in a stalemate.

review_details.concern_detail: No human reviewer engaged with the PR. The only non-bot comments are from changeset-bot and socket-security bot. Devin bot closed the PR after 7+ days of inactivity.
review_details.performance_claim: Reduce compressed node_modules size from ~125MB to ≤50MB, cut package count by ≥40%, eliminate deprecated packages, and reduce duplicate library versions.
review_details.rejection_signals: Closed by bot due to inactivity; no human rejection signals.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: The PR introduced a large-scale dependency optimization but failed to attract maintainer attention, highlighting a process boundary where agent-authored refactors require explicit human champions to avoid stalemate.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: The PR body lists aspirational size targets (e.g., 125MB→≤50MB) but lacks any verifiable before/after metrics or a reproducible measurement pipeline.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merge; no human-triggered regression handling occurred.

core_change_summary.description: Replaced node-fetch with native fetch across all CLI command and utility files; inlined small utility packages (ms, bytes, strip-ansi, title) and updated imports; updated semver, removed deprecated packages (codecov, glob, @types/jest-expect-message); updated lockfile and added scripts for automated replacements.
files_secondary_observability: Many other CLI source files (commands/*, util/*, test/*) with import changes
core_change_summary.secondary_note: The bulk of changes are import updates across 100+ files to replace node-fetch with native fetch and to use inlined utilities; no logic changes.
change_trajectory: Commit e2b68c8: replaced node-fetch with native fetch across ~80+ files.
Commit d2988e0: inlined small utility packages with added inline files and updated imports.
Commits 4ec8162, ba55549, 8441ee: updated semver, bumped minor versions, removed deprecated packages.
Commit 7e208cd: fixed import paths for inlined packages.
Commit c13b3f9: added dependency audit script and CSV.

review_signals.summary: Bot detected a changeset and noted the PR will cause a minor version bump for the vercel package.
Provided a detailed dependency diff report with supply chain scores; no blocking issues flagged.
Devin bot introduced itself and announced it would automatically address comments and CI failures.
Closing due to inactivity for more than 7 days.

collaboration_trajectory: No human reviewer engaged; only automated bot responses within minutes of PR creation.
PR sat without human attention for 8 days.
Devin bot auto-closed the PR for inactivity.
